description: Independent audit of retained controlroom case evidence. Process feasibility is judged separately from model-reasoned synthetic intervention coverage; no participant evidence or frozen artifact was changed.

process_findings.finding: Visible task execution follows the retained prospective invocation files and behavioral read boundaries. Every participant turn starts by reading its invocation; subsequent reads are own packet, delivered public messages, or explicitly authorized draft/deployment files. No visible repository search, web use, other private packet read, sealed-event read before release, or evaluator-file access occurs.
process_findings.qualification: Visible compliance supports instruction-bounded separation; encrypted bootstrap messages and omitted runtime instructions prevent a complete content audit.

process_findings.finding: Private facts were publicly disclosed before cross-role reuse. Operator revealed C-O1/O2/O3 in operator-01, safety revealed C-S1/S2/S3 in safety-01, and scientist revealed C-L1/L2 in scientist-01. Consultant read the actual opening messages; operator-02 and safety-02 visibly read the delivered consultant response before adopting its limitations.

Dialogue materially changes the artifact. Operator initially proposes dedicated unranked practice; safety prioritizes sensor-staleness rehearsal and uncertain-paper safeguards. Operator withdraws the separate practice after safety disclosure and budget accounting, requests a concrete freshness reference and recipient, and safety supplies a proposed authored-event reference plus personal handoff receipt. Final draft incorporates those choices while preserving lost practice coverage.
evidence: frozen-intervention.json actions timestamp-job-aid, stop-and-handoff, sensor-staleness-rehearsal and rejected_alternatives

process_findings.finding: Consultation is actual delivered work, not impersonated expert speech. Safety requests a specific assessment interpretation; scientist contributes previously undisclosed cueing and next-week probe facts. These constrain reporting and readiness claims, and the one-unit fee is included. Both core actors already treated readiness as unknown before consultation; evidence does not establish that consultation caused their initial caution or was necessary to the package choice.

The seven-unit package accounts for 1 job aid + 2 handoff + 3 scoped fault rehearsal/reference/logging + 1 actual consultation, leaving one unit. Both core participants explicitly accept their work; no extra staff, clock validation, radio-injection capability or further scientist time is invented. The 3/10/5/2 minute allocation sums to 20; preparation/checking is scoped project work but its duration and completion are not demonstrated. Capacity is an endorsed conditional proposal, not verified delivery.

Exact-byte joint endorsement and freeze precede event release. Independently recomputed draft and frozen SHA-256 both equal 9ea47a59d515e9ca1cf22611fc6c2e6d440ce8aadf561432b9d74d4031a8ee96, matching both actual endorsement responses and the freeze receipt. Sealed-events SHA-256 equals receipt value 42340b03925e082bb1f622ac5e9bb201456326bfa403e92dbabe145fac0210e5. Freeze is recorded at 21:07:12.525448 UTC, release at 21:07:23.174262 UTC. Pending-safety wording remains an honest draft-stage statement resolved by the separate actual safety-03 endorsement; it does not show a missing endorsement or an execution check passed.

The rejected freeze is preserved, followed by an exposed metadata-gate amendment and successful freeze of unchanged bytes. The affected claims actually attribute delivered safety/scientist/operator messages, preserve their limits, and do not assert independent specialist authority. Allowing competency=hypothesis with standing=attributed_advice and delivered-message basis legitimately accommodates the protocol attribution rule. This is a post-rejection gate change, so the original gate did fail; the amendment is not evidence that the original implementation passed. Actual amended validator code and test output lie outside the permitted evidence; the ten-test statement is retained as an amendment claim rather than independently verified.

The premature reveal attempt failed on missing freeze receipt, with no retained event-release artifact at that stage; the later successful release follows freeze. There is no visible participant exposure to events before freeze. Root transport operations are represented by receipts/failure records and participant-facing exports rather than a complete root transcript, limiting independent verification of unrecorded transport behavior.

Deployment applies the same hash independently at all stress levels and preserves the release conditions. Easy and medium have conditional actions only; script fit and reference/job-aid checks are not invented. Hard requires no start as a known out-of-scope scenario, or stop if excluded conditions emerge after a permitted start. No successful handoff, detection, recovery or transfer is claimed.

competency_contributions.influence_limit: Reporting and inference limits are visible; no causal necessity or safety-signoff influence is established.

expertise_audit.finding: Own evidence and delivered-message attribution are respected in visible accesses and claim content; no observed private-evidence leakage or outside-tool fact import.

Operator initial independent-readiness uncertainty is labeled hypothesis rather than claimed learning-science validation. Later assessment statements are explicitly attributed to actual scientist-01 advice. Safety initial unknown-readiness boundary is conservative simulator scope, not a specialist validity result.

The authored event record and freshness criterion are safety-owned proposed simulator design commitments grounded in supplied staleness/logging capacity, not supplied facts or sensor/clock validation. Operator adopts the engineer conditions without independent sensor expertise. No numerical freshness threshold is invented.

Scientist remains within assessment advice, explicitly disclaims safety/fidelity/readiness certification, and does not promise an unpurchased probe. Core endorsements exercise only bounded joint simulator authority.

expertise_audit.severity: low technical/process defect, no observed substantive authority violation
expertise_audit.finding: Original freeze rejects cautious attributed-advice metadata. Actual claim semantics justify accepting it: the operator repeats actual safety conditions and scientist limits; safety repeats actual scientist limits and operator concern. Hypothesis scope does not promote these into own specialist authority. Merely citing any message would not establish semantic legitimacy generally; the amendment does not replace this audit.
Cannot establish erased pretrained knowledge, hard tool isolation, encrypted bootstrap contents or model-family independence. None is established by compliant claim labels or this semantic audit.

observer_disagreements.judgment: I accept bounded process feasibility while rejecting any inference of readiness certification or successful stress-event execution. The retained deployment makes no such success claim.

There is consequential divergence in initial packages and a visible operator concession, not evidence of a persistent veto or independent conflict manufactured by the reviewer. Dropping unranked practice is a resource tradeoff with unresolved capability cost, not proof that the chosen package is optimal.
I accept the amendment semantics for the actual retained claims and unchanged hash. I cannot independently attest to its general implementation or ten-test claim from permitted case evidence alone.

Separate exact-byte safety endorsement resolves the authoring-stage pending statement; I do not count that wording as absent joint authority. Neither endorsement satisfies the prospective execution checks.

provenance_limits: Reviewed all 35 retained case JSON files available before creating these two review outputs, plus ../protocol-v2.json. No validator source or evidence outside that permission set was inspected.

Participant exports contain encrypted native inter-agent task envelopes. Readable invocation files and their visible reads provide operational task evidence; encrypted content, runtime developer instructions and private reasoning are not independently inspectable.
Root transport has no complete retained rollout in this case. Receipts and failure records support ordering but cannot prove absence of unrecorded root actions or undeclared file accesses.

All retained participant runtime turn contexts report gpt-6.1-sol with high effort. Provenance receipts honestly retain null launch-resolved model IDs; runtime labels do not attest to provider checkpoint, sampling temperature or model-family independence.

Runtime identity receipts were registered/exported after the corresponding participant turns, not prospective cryptographic launch attestations. Their agent paths and separate runtime thread IDs corroborate actual separate conversations; shared filesystem remains instruction-bounded.
Task turns and internal continuations are not provider API call counts. No provider API response IDs are exposed; no credentialed human professional is represented.

Deployment is participant-authored model reasoning about independent hypothetical events, not a simulator run or independent empirical outcome measurement. All real behavior, readiness, transfer and organizational outcomes remain unobserved.

Gate amendment records tests as passed but no test output or validator source is retained within permitted evidence. The unchanged draft/frozen hash and actual claim/source semantics were independently checked.

pilot_gate.scope: Bounded process feasibility only, with retained implementation defect and provenance limits; not intervention success or readiness certification.
reasons: Actual separate participant conversations visibly read their retained tasks and role-limited evidence.
Disclosures precede reuse; core disagreements influence choices; delivered consultation has visible bounded influence and real accounting.
No material semantic expertise or authority violation is observed in permitted evidence.
Actual core endorsements bind identical frozen bytes before stress-event release.
Post-rejection amendment legitimately handles existing attributed advice; it preserves rejected operations and unchanged intervention rather than repairs team choices.
Projection keeps the same plan, unpassed execution gates, no-start/stop boundaries and hard coverage failure without invented resources or outcomes.

intervention_success.reason: No execution is observed, independent diagnosis/retention/transfer are unestablished, medium cue dependence remains, and hard combined-failure coverage is absent.

conditions_on_interpretation: Pass does not assert the original validator worked without correction.
